# A silenced message must not introduce a private owner dependency into
# an instance printed in the caller. Its local-only uses must survive.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^1 2 3 4$'
logos eject -o out
! grep 'unsupported' out/main.go
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
stdout '^1 2 3 4$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/silenterror

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/silenterror/owner"
	"fmt"
)

type localInt int

func main() {
	fmt.Println(owner.Pick[localInt](), owner.Deferred[localInt](), owner.Local[localInt](), owner.Capture[localInt]())
}

-- m/owner/pick.lgo --
package owner

import (
	"comptime"
	"unsafe"
)

const unsupported = "unsupported"

func Pick[T any]() int {
	const switch T {
	case ~int:
		return 1
	}
	comptime.Error(unsupported)
	return 0
}

func Deferred[T any]() int {
	const switch T {
	case ~int:
		return 2
	}
	defer comptime.Error(unsupported)
	return 0
}

func Local[T any]() int {
	var marker byte
	const switch T {
	case ~int:
		return 3
	}
	comptime.Error(unsupported + string('0' + unsafe.Sizeof(marker)))
	return 0
}

func Capture[T any]() int {
	var outer byte
	const switch T {
	case ~int:
		return 4
	}
	comptime.Error(unsupported + string('0' + unsafe.Sizeof(func() {
		var inner byte
		_ = inner
		_ = outer
	})))
	return 0
}
